caseNameFull: Kugler, Attorney General of New Jersey v. Karp

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. J. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of judgment of this Court in No. 2, Younger v. Harris [ante, p. 37], No. 7, Samuels v. Mackell, and No. 9, Fernandez v. Mackell [ante, p. 66]. Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that the judgment should be affirmed for reasons set forth in his dissenting opinion in Younger v. Harris, ante, p. 58.
